_source: CBP ruling N262359 (6 Apr 2015): a suction manifold of seamless steel pipe from China with elbows, fittings and plate mounts welded on in Canada (the assembly without valves): CBP held China, the pipe's country, under 102.11(b)(1). In the D580 selection pool (Part 102, dated before 2024, in no development or held-out split) and excluded. Target by the D171 rule; plant capabilities at the target are an assumption.

product.name: Seamless pipe suction manifold
product.description: Lengths of seamless steel pipe with fittings welded on, forming a suction manifold that clamps to a trailer.

operations.name: cut the pipe and weld on the elbows, fittings and plate mounts
